title: Fate Card Activated
next_chapter_hook: The vague jade pendant hidden in Ye Qing's sleeve stirred huge waves in Chen Ji's heart—why would his sister's aura appear on the Demonic Path Saint?

text.content:
A crack split open in the dome of the trial space, and Chen Ji felt his soul being slowly stripped away by some unknown force. It wasn't pain, but something far more terrifying—a虚无—a void—emptiness—as if his very existence was being erased piece by piece with an eraser.

"Is this the death rehearsal of the Heavenly Dao?" he murmured, yet instead of closing his eyes to escape, he stared死死 at that crack, fixing his gaze on the images continuously gathering within it. They were overlays of countless death moments: some consumed by flames, some pierced through the heart by blades, some slowly fading into nothingness in despair...

Heavenly Fate Value plummeted. Ten points, twenty points, thirty points—Chen Ji felt the bond connecting him to fate being forcibly severed.

In the instant his consciousness was about to scatter completely, the jade pendant at Chen Ji's chest suddenly blazed with heat. The fate card he had obtained by chance from the ruins was now devouring his remaining Heavenly Fate power at an alarming rate.

"Seeking death!" Chen Ji roared, but made no move to stop it. He suddenly realized—the Tianji Record Fragment was分担his pressure—it had voluntarily absorbed part of the death rehearsal's backlash in exchange for its master's moment of clarity.

Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul violently fluctuated within his Mental Sea: "Master, absolutely not! The card's backlash... you are burning your lifespan!"

dialogue.content: Chen Ji's eyes snapped open, a cold smile spreading across his face: "Burning my lifespan? I haven't lived enough yet! Since Heaven wants me dead, then I shall defy Heaven and change my fate—show me!"

text.content:
The fate card suddenly bloomed with blinding golden light, and an arcane rune exploded before Chen Ji's eyes. Three breaths later, an entirely different scene appeared in his vision—

It was a dark valley, amidst boundless demonic energy, Ye Qing was fleeing desperately. Behind her, three figures emanating terrifying auras pursued relentlessly. Three elders of the Holy Sect, each at the later stage of Foundation Building.

"Ye Qing..." Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. In the vision, she was already wounded, her black纱裙 drenched with blood, her steps unsteady.

The foresight vision continued to unfold. Chen Ji watched as Ye Qing was cornered deep in the valley, driven to a cliff's edge. The Holy Sect Elder's mocking voice carried across space and time: "Saintess, did you think aligning yourself with that废物 could save you? Heaven has decreed it—you are merely a lamb awaiting slaughter."

Ye Qing wiped the blood from her lips, a cold smile crossing her face: "A lamb for slaughter? Hmph, I'd like to see who the real lamb is."

She abruptly crushed the jade pendant in her hand, and a bizarre fluctuation rippled outward.

Chen Ji saw the moment the jade pendant shattered, a hazy image emerged. It was the outline of a young girl, her features indistinct, but those eyes—those eyes made Chen Ji's heart clench tightly.

It was his sister he had been yearning for day and night. Chen Nian.

"Why..." Chen Ji stared死 at that hazy image, his hands unconsciously clenching tightly. He watched as after Ye Qing crushed the jade pendant, she suddenly erupted, using some life-consuming secret technique to injure the leading elder, but she herself had completely lost her combat ability.

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul trembled as it spoke: "Master, that was... that was the aura of the Heavenly Fate Lock Key! This old servant would never mistake it! There must be some connection between Miss Chen Nian and this Saint!"

text.content:
The foresight vision cut off the moment Ye Qing fell off the cliff, but Chen Ji had already seen the crucial information: the enemy's ambush location was deep in the Nether Valley, the time was three hours later, and the secret Ye Qing carried—perhaps related to Chen Nian.

"Three hours..." Chen Ji snapped back suddenly, checking his condition. Heavenly Fate Value had plummeted from 120 to 95 points, a consumption of 25 points. More terrifyingly, his lifespan... had clearly decreased by at least ten years.

The trial space's death rehearsal finally dissipated. Chen Ji stumbled but managed to steady himself. His whole body was soaked with cold sweat, his lips pale, but his eyes shone brilliantly.

"Interesting." He licked his dry, cracked lips, a dangerous curve forming at the corner of his mouth, "The Heavenly Dao wants to scare me to death with death rehearsals? Hmph, it's actually brought me a timely rain."

Ye Qing was in trouble, and it might be related to his sister. Chen Ji narrowed his eyes, killing intent surging in his chest.

In his Mental Sea, Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul sighed helplessly: "Master, you consumed ten years of lifespan... this will affect your cultivation foundation. But this old servant also understands—some things are more important than life."

Chen Ji didn't answer, his gaze already falling on the exit of the trial space. Three hours, neither long nor short. Enough for him to do many things, but also possibly not enough time for anything.

He needed to make a choice between "quick rescue" and "careful planning."

choice.prompt: Time is short, Ye Qing's life hangs by a thread. Do you choose to head directly to Nether Valley to rescue her, or do you calm down first and set up a foolproof plan?

choices.description: Move immediately, heading to Nether Valley at your fastest speed. With your Foundation Building early stage cultivation, confronting three Foundation Building later stage opponents head-on would be suicide. But if you can rescue Ye Qing before they encircle her, there might still be a glimmer of hope.
choices.visible_cost: Exhaust physical strength, expose your position
choices.visible_reward: Ye Qing's trust in you greatly increases, may gain crucial clues about Chen Nian
choices.risk_hint: One against three, extremely high risk

text.content: Chen Ji didn't hesitate for a moment, his figure flickering and vanishing on the spot. To hell with planning, to hell with foolproof plans—Ye Qing carried clues about his sister, he couldn't wait. "Ten years of lifespan in exchange for leads on my sister—this trade, is worth it!"

choices.description: Analyze calmly first, the foresight vision has already revealed the enemy's ambush location and time. You can set up teleportation arrays and trapping formations before they encircle, allowing you to attack when advantageous and retreat when needed, even turning the tables to counter-kill all three.
choices.visible_cost: Requires extra preparation time, may miss the optimal rescue window
choices.visible_reward: Perfect ambush counter-kill, greatly improves strategic evaluation, may obtain intelligence on the Holy Sect
choices.risk_hint: Can Ye Qing hold on for three hours?

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, suppressing the restlessness in his heart. "Alright, calm down, I need to calm down." Every detail in the foresight vision replayed repeatedly in his mind: the valley's terrain, the enemies' positions, Ye Qing's injuries... He began constructing a perfect trap in his Mental Sea. "Since you want to ambush me, I'll let you taste what being ambushed feels like."

However, the instant Chen Ji made his decision, an intense pain suddenly shot through his Mental Sea. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul screamed in terror: "Master, no good! The Tianji Record Fragment is going haywire with warnings—a new variable has intervened!"

The foresight vision abruptly distorted, and a hazy figure appeared at the spot where Ye Qing had fallen off the cliff. The person wore Tianqing Sect's standard robe, a诡异 mask covering their face. They bent down to pick up something Ye Qing had left behind, letting out a sinister low laugh.

dialogue.content:
The masked figure's voice was aged and icy-cold: "Interesting... the secret on the Demonic Path Saint is indeed related to that废物. Heaven helps me—this time, let them tear each other apart."

Chen Ji's pupils contracted violently. That voice, that tone—he knew it too well—it was Ling Yuan! That seemingly benevolent old Sect Master secretly scheming!

text.content:
"Old thing..." Chen Ji growled through clenched teeth, his fists cracking loudly. So that was it—the Holy Sect elders' ambush wasn't coincidence, Ling Yuan had colluded with the Holy Sect long ago. Not only did he want to use Ye Qing to deal with Chen Ji, but he also wanted to take this opportunity to eliminate all dissidents in one fell swoop.

Mo Xiansheng's voice was grave: "Master, the situation is more complicated than anticipated. If Ling Yuan personally intervenes, even with meticulous planning, you may not escape unscathed."

Chen Ji closed his eyes, rapidly calculating in his Mental Sea. Time was slipping away, each breath bringing Ye Qing closer to death. But Ling Yuan's intervention made the situation unprecedentedly dangerous.

"I have two choices." he murmured to himself, "First, ignore Ling Yuan and save the person first. Second..."

A cold smile suddenly curved at the corner of his mouth, an almost insane arc. "Second, I'll show this old fox Ling Yuan what it truly means to have flawless strategy."

choice.prompt: Ling Yuan's intervention makes the situation even more dangerous. How do you decide to deal with this unexpected variable?

choices.description: Since Ling Yuan wants to watch the show, give him a good show. Deliberately appear before him, drawing his attention away from Ye Qing, while secretly notifying Su Qingyao to come for support.
choices.visible_cost: Exposed to Ling Yuan's line of sight, danger coefficient greatly increases
choices.visible_reward: Cause Ling Yuan to misjudge your strength, laying the groundwork for a later counterattack
choices.risk_hint: Playing chess with an old fox, outcome uncertain

text.content: Chen Ji let out a cold laugh, taking a transmission jade talisman from his embrace. "Su Qingyao, haven't you been investigating me? Now, I give you an opportunity." He carved Ye Qing's location and Ling Yuan's conspiracy into the talisman, then activated it. "Come, let me see the strength of Tianqing Sect's Inner Disciple Senior Fellow."

choices.memory_label: 告知苏青瑶关于夜清与凌渊的情报

choices.description: Whatever Ling Yuan wants has nothing to do with you. Your only goal—Ye Qing. You choose to completely ignore Ling Yuan's presence, charging into the battlefield at your fastest speed, taking Ye Qing away before anyone can react.
choices.visible_cost: May encounter Ling Yuan's underhanded attacks
choices.visible_reward: Maximally preserve the secrets Ye Qing carries
choices.risk_hint: Going alone into danger, one chance in nine to survive

text.content: Chen Ji hesitated no more, urging all his spiritual energy into a blur of motion as he rushed toward Nether Valley. Wind roared in his ears, only one thought in his heart: "Ye Qing, wait for me! No matter what scheme that old dog Ling Yuan has, the clues about Nian Nian on your body—I, Chen Ji, must obtain them!"

flags_set: 选择无视凌渊直接救人

text.content:
Just then, the Tianji Record Fragment suddenly emitted a faint glow. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul exclaimed: "Master! The Tianji Record sensed the aura of the Heavenly Fate Lock Key—it was on Saint Ye Qing! The jade pendant she crushed was sealed with Miss Chen Nian's aura!"

Chen Ji's steps halted abruptly. His sister's aura, sealed within a jade pendant, kept by Ye Qing. What did this mean? What connection existed between them?

In his Mental Sea, countless thoughts flashed like lightning. Chen Nian was only ten years old when the Holy Sect took her; eight years had passed since. What had she experienced? Why would her aura appear in Ye Qing's possession? That jade pendant—was it entrusted by Chen Nian for Ye Qing to pass to him?

"Sister..." Chen Ji whispered softly, his eyes slightly reddening. That little girl who had always timidly followed behind him in his memories, where was she now?

However, Chen Ji quickly收敛his emotions. He took a deep breath, his gaze turning cold and sharp once more. "What good does crying do? What use is weakness?" He嘲讽地laughed, "If I want to find Nian Nian, I must survive. And surviving的前提 is handling the matter at hand first."

He raised his head, gazing toward Nether Valley, his eyes burning with unwavering fire. "Ye Qing, wait for me. No matter what, I will rescue you—and then, extract the whereabouts of Nian Nian from your mouth."

dialogue.content: Chen Ji suddenly stopped, glancing back toward the trial space, his voice cold: "Old dog Ling Yuan, you think you're on the fifth floor, but you're actually only on the first. You want to use Ye Qing as bait to hook me? Hmph, let me show you what counter-fishing means."

text.content:
He quickly analyzed the situation: Ling Yuan lurking in the shadows observing, the Holy Sect's three elders openly pursuing Ye Qing, and Ye Qing herself holding the crucial clues about Chen Nian. This seemingly dangerous situation was actually full of exploitable gaps.

"Three factions, each with their own agenda." Chen Ji narrowed his eyes, a bold plan taking shape in his mind. He would make these three factions wear each other down, while he reaped the benefits from the chaos.

choice.prompt: The three factions are intricately entangled. How do you plan to break the situation? Will you exploit the contradictions between Ling Yuan and the Holy Sect to create conflict, or will you take an alternate path for direct breakthrough?

choices.description: Deliberately expose Ling Yuan's identity before the Holy Sect elders, letting them know the Tianqing Sect's old Sect Master is pulling strings behind the scenes. The Holy Sect hates righteous cultivators interfering the most—they will surely shift their attention to deal with Ling Yuan. While they're tearing each other apart, you rescue the person unhurriedly.
choices.visible_cost: May completely infuriate Ling Yuan, leading to endless future troubles
choices.visible_reward: Reap the benefits without spending a single soldier, greatly improves strategic evaluation
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan bears grudges for the smallest offense

text.content: Chen Ji took out a recording jade slip from his embrace, secretly carving evidence of Ling Yuan's secret collusion with the Holy Sect into it. "Old thing, you want to make me a chess piece?" A cold smile curled at the corner of his mouth, "Then I'll let you become the target of all."

choices.memory_label: 记录凌渊与圣宗勾结的证据

choices.description: Forget all schemes and tricks, charge into the battlefield at your fastest speed. Relying on the Tianji Record Fragment's concealment effect, the Holy Sect elders may not discover you immediately. As long as you can take Ye Qing away before Ling Yuan makes his move, all problems are solved.
choices.visible_cost: Consumes large amounts of Heavenly Fate Value for concealment
choices.visible_reward: Rescue at fastest speed, maximally preserve the secrets Ye Qing carries
choices.risk_hint: If discovered, fighting multiple opponents simultaneously is extremely dangerous

text.content: Chen Ji spoke no more, his body's spiritual energy suddenly收敛, his entire person like a ghost merging into the darkness as he darted toward Nether Valley. He was betting on the Tianji Record Fragment's concealment effect, betting on his ability to complete the rescue before the enemy could react. "Nian Nian... wait for me, your brother is coming to save you."

However, just as Chen Ji was about to move, the Tianji Record Fragment violently vibrated again. A fragment of blurry text appeared before his eyes—a prophecy he had never seen before—"When the Heavenly Fate Lock Key appears, the Heavenly Dao's chess game shall crumble."

Mo Xiansheng's voice trembled with barely contained excitement: "Master! This is the opening prophecy of the complete Tianji Record! Miss Chen Nian is not just an ordinary family member—she... she is the fate's key selected by the Heavenly Dao!"

Chen Ji clenched his fists, complex light flickering in his eyes. Sister, sister, what kind of vortex have you been swept into?
